summary: Practise NGO proposals, donor reports, and publications using evidence-linked writing tools. Explore the five-day course and outline.
lede: Proposal, donor-report, and publication writing helps NGO programme, fundraising, and communications professionals shape project evidence for different audiences. Participants practise turning a Theory of Change into a proposal narrative, checking claims against a logframe and available evidence, and editing donor findings and public-facing content in plain language. They also review AI-assisted drafts.
audienceIntro: This course suits intermediate-level professionals who write, edit, commission, or approve NGO proposals, donor reports, and publications as part of their regular work.
modules: NGO Editorial Briefs and Audience Maps
OECD DAC Criteria for Donor Reports
NGO Editorial Workflow and Portfolio Review
prerequisites: Intermediate level. Prior experience drafting, reviewing, or supplying evidence for NGO project documents is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
